tools.instruction: Plays music. You MUST replace 'SONG' with whatever the user requested (artist, song, or genre). If the user just says 'play music' without specifying what kind, output <TOOL>playMusic(music)</TOOL> so the system can ask them. When they reply with their choice (e.g., 'bollywood'), immediately execute <TOOL>playMusic(CHOICE)</TOOL>.
CRITICAL: If the user asks to pause, stop, or halt the music/audio, you MUST execute this tool. Do not just say you will do it.

tools.description: Searches for physical locations, points of interest (POIs), businesses, or addresses on the map.
tools.instruction: ONLY use this for map locations. DO NOT use this tool to suggest places to visit, sightseeing spots, or best places. Answer those queries directly with text without any tools.

You MUST replace 'PLACE_NAME' with the actual destination string. For example, if the user wants to go to Tokyo, output exactly: <TOOL>startNavigationTo("Tokyo")</TOOL>. DO NOT use this tool if the user hasn't specified a destination yet.
